text.title: Growth Referral Programs Worked Example
text.summary: One complete referral-programme spec for a B2B SaaS exporting tool (NPS 42 on 640 active users, prompt on first_successful_export reached by 57 percent, reward on a first paid order of 50 USD or more, 20 USD credit plus 20 USD discount against paid CAC 95 and first-order margin 126, four-signal self-referral matching with a 30-day hold, K 0.741 on 4,200 invites presented as a 3.86x multiplier, per-user codes persisted at account creation, announcement, 14-day reminder and two-sided confirmation, published terms) with a note per value, plus a "refer a friend" spec that pays on signup and what the validator prints.

section.title: Scenario
section.p: A B2B SaaS data tool wants a referral programme. Its NPS survey ran 30 days ago on 640 active users and scored 42. Users hit their first real outcome, a successful export, on day 3 on average; 57 percent of sign-ups get there. Paid CAC is 95 USD, the average first order is 180 USD at 70 percent gross margin (126 USD). A 6-week beta of the share link on 850 referrers produced 4,200 invites and 630 referee sign-ups. The team wants to launch with 20 USD on each side and needs to know whether that survives the economics, the fraud guard and the K projection.

example.title: give 20 get 20
example.code: { "programme_name": "give 20 get 20", "nps_gate": {"metric": "nps", "score": 42, "sample_size": 640, "population": "active_users", "measured_on": "2026-08-14", "age_days": 30}, "trigger_event": {"name": "first_successful_export", "reach_share": 0.57, "instrumented": true}, "qualifying_event": {"kind": "first_paid_order", "name": "first_paid_order", "minimum_order_value": 50, "stated_on_landing_page": true, "stated_in_every_email": true}, "incentive": { "referrer_reward": {"kind": "account_credit", "amount": 20, "currency": "USD"}, "referee_reward": {"kind": "discount", "amount": 20, "currency": "USD"}, "reward_cost_per_qualified_referee": 40, "blended_paid_cac": 95, "margin_basis": "first_order_gross_margin", "margin_basis_value": 126, "max_reward_share_of_basis": 0.35 }, "fraud_guard": { "referee_must_be_new_account": true, "one_referral_per_email": true, "one_referral_per_payment_instrument": true, "self_referral_signals": ["payment_instrument", "device_fingerprint", "ip", "normalised_email"], "email_normalisation": ["plus_addressing", "dot_variants"], "reward_hold_days": 30, "reward_hold_covers": "refund_window", "idempotency_key": ["referrer_id", "referee_id", "qualifying_event"] }, "k_factor": { "invites": 4200, "active_referrers": 850, "referee_signups": 630, "invites_per_referrer": 4.94, "conversion_per_invite": 0.15, "k": 0.741, "cycle_time_days": 9, "presented_as": "cac_multiplier", "cac_multiplier": 3.86, "netted_of_reward_cost": true }, "attribution": { "per_user_code": true, "landing_page_accepts_param": true, "email_accepts_param": true, "capture_methods": ["url_parameter", "first_party_cookie", "code_at_signup"], "persisted_server_side_at": "referee_account_creation", "utm_only": false }, "lifecycle": { "announcement": {"send_on": "first_successful_export"}, "reminder": {"after_days": 14, "audience": "zero_referrals", "max_sends": 1}, "confirmation": {"send_on": "qualifying_event", "recipients": ["referrer", "referee"]}, "promises_reward_before_qualifying_event": false }, "disclosure": { "reward_disclosed_on_shared_content": true, "terms_url": "https://example.com/referral-terms", "terms_cover": ["qualifying_event", "reward_timing", "exclusions", "fraud_reversal"], "earnings_claims": [{"claim": "this month's top referrer has earned 300 USD", "period": "2026-08", "verified": true}] } }
example.note: NPS 42 on 640 active users, 30 days old, clears the gate of 30 within 90 days; a score from last year would not (r-nps-gate-30-before-launch). The prompt fires on `first_successful_export`, the first moment the user has something to recommend, and 0.57 is what makes the invites-per-user projection honest (r-trigger-event-at-value-moment). The reward releases on a first paid order of at least 50 USD, the figure the landing page FAQ states, never on account creation (r-reward-on-qualifying-event-not-signup). 20 USD credit plus 20 USD discount is 40 USD per qualified referee: below paid CAC 95 and below 0.35 x 126 = 44.10 of first-order margin, so every successful referral is cheaper than a paid one (r-double-sided-incentive-within-unit-economics). Self-referral matching covers all four signals with plus-addressing and dot variants collapsed, the reward is held 30 days for the refund window, and fulfilment is keyed on the (referrer_id, referee_id, qualifying_event) tuple so a queue retry cannot pay twice (r-fraud-guard-self-referral-and-idempotent-rewards). K uses the beta's 4,200 invites and 850 referrers, above the 500 and 50 floors: 4200 / 850 = 4.94 invites per referrer, 630 / 4200 = 0.15 conversion, K = 0.741, the same numbers `templates/k_factor.py` returns; because K is below 1 it is presented as a 1 / (1 - 0.741) = 3.86 multiplier on other acquisition, with a 9-day median cycle and reward cost netted (r-k-factor-computed-on-500-plus-invites). Every user gets a unique code; the link is captured by URL parameter, first-party cookie or a code typed at sign-up and stored on the referee account at creation, so a referee who opens on a phone and signs up on a laptop is still attributed (r-referral-attribution-server-side). The announcement goes out on the trigger event, one reminder after 14 days only to users with zero referrals, and a confirmation to both sides when the order qualifies; no message promises the reward earlier (r-lifecycle-sequence-trigger-reminder-confirmation). Shared content discloses the reward, the terms page covers all four topics, and the "300 USD" claim is verified for August 2026 (r-incentive-disclosure-and-published-terms).

example.title: refer a friend, paid on signup
example.code: { "programme_name": "refer a friend", "nps_gate": {"metric": "nps", "score": 22, "sample_size": 40, "population": "active_users", "measured_on": "2025-06-01", "age_days": 400}, "trigger_event": {"name": "signup", "reach_share": 1, "instrumented": true}, "qualifying_event": {"kind": "activation_milestone", "name": "account_created", "stated_on_landing_page": false, "stated_in_every_email": false}, "incentive": { "referrer_reward": {"kind": "account_credit", "amount": 20, "currency": "USD"}, "referee_reward": {"kind": "discount", "amount": 0, "currency": "USD"}, "reward_cost_per_qualified_referee": 20, "blended_paid_cac": 15, "margin_basis": "first_order_gross_margin", "margin_basis_value": 18, "max_reward_share_of_basis": 0.5 }, "fraud_guard": { "referee_must_be_new_account": false, "one_referral_per_email": true, "one_referral_per_payment_instrument": false, "self_referral_signals": ["ip"], "email_normalisation": [], "reward_hold_days": 0, "reward_hold_covers": "none", "idempotency_key": ["referrer_id"] }, "k_factor": { "invites": 30, "active_referrers": 6, "referee_signups": 4, "invites_per_referrer": 5, "conversion_per_invite": 0.133, "k": 0.9, "cycle_time_days": 7, "presented_as": "viral_growth", "cac_multiplier": 1, "netted_of_reward_cost": false }, "attribution": { "per_user_code": false, "landing_page_accepts_param": true, "email_accepts_param": false, "capture_methods": ["utm_source"], "persisted_server_side_at": "analytics_session", "utm_only": true }, "lifecycle": { "announcement": {"send_on": "signup"}, "reminder": {"after_days": 3, "audience": "all_users", "max_sends": 4}, "confirmation": {"send_on": "signup", "recipients": ["referrer"]}, "promises_reward_before_qualifying_event": true }, "disclosure": { "reward_disclosed_on_shared_content": false, "terms_url": "", "terms_cover": ["reward_timing"], "earnings_claims": [{"claim": "top referrer earned 300 USD", "period": "", "verified": false}] } }
example.note: What the validator prints: `nps_gate.score` 22 is below 30 and `age_days` 400 is above 90 (r-nps-gate-30-before-launch); `trigger_event.name` signup is in the forbidden list (r-trigger-event-at-value-moment); `qualifying_event.name` account_created is forbidden and the condition is stated nowhere (r-reward-on-qualifying-event-not-signup); `referee_reward.amount` 0 is not above 0 (r-double-sided-incentive-within-unit-economics); `self_referral_signals` lacks payment_instrument, device_fingerprint and normalised_email, `email_normalisation` is empty, `reward_hold_days` 0, `reward_hold_covers` none, `idempotency_key` has 1 item where 3 are required (r-fraud-guard-self-referral-and-idempotent-rewards); `invites` 30 is below 500, `active_referrers` 6 below 50, `presented_as` must be cac_multiplier for K below 1, `netted_of_reward_cost` false (r-k-factor-computed-on-500-plus-invites); `per_user_code` false, `capture_methods` utm_source not in the enum, `persisted_server_side_at` analytics_session, `utm_only` true (r-referral-attribution-server-side); `reminder.audience` all_users, `max_sends` 4, `confirmation.send_on` signup with only the referrer, `promises_reward_before_qualifying_event` true (r-lifecycle-sequence-trigger-reminder-confirmation); disclosure false, empty `terms_url`, `terms_cover` with 1 of 4 topics, an earnings claim with an empty period and `verified` false (r-incentive-disclosure-and-published-terms). Once the schema violations are fixed the cross-field checks add: 20 per referee exceeds paid CAC 15 and 0.5 x 18 = 9, K 0.9 is not 5 x 0.133, and 1 is not 1 / (1 - 0.9).
